decisions.rationale: Initial exploration across diverse parameter values to establish main effects relative to the baseline evaluation.
s1 in {A, D} yields very low f1 but high f2, correlated with s4=B. Testing s1=D and s1=A with s4=A to seek a balanced trade-off, while probing s1=C combinations to further reduce f2.
s4=B with s3=E yields ultra-low f1, while s1=C and s3=C give the lowest f2. Testing s3=E with s2=B or alternative s5 explores better f2 trade-offs.
s2=A yields extremely low f1 when paired with s4=B and s3=E, while s5=D optimizes f2. We test s1=E/A with this low-f1 backbone, and probe s3=C configurations with low f2.
Combine top f1 driver (s2=A, s4=B) and top f2 drivers (s1=E, s3=C or s5=D) to find non-dominated trade-offs between low f1 and low f2.
Investigate low f2 regions with s3=C and s5=D across alternate s1 and s2 values, as s3=C reliably achieves the lowest f2 values while s2=A significantly reduces f1.
s1=E with s2=B and s3=C yields the best f2 (1984), while s2=A with s4=B minimizes f1. Exploring other s5 values with s1=E,s2=B,s3=C, and testing s3=D/A with s2=B.
Investigate s1=E with s2=B and other s3/s4 combinations where s5=D gives the lowest f2, while testing s3=A and s3=B to find superior trade-offs on the low-f2 boundary.
Explores the low f2 region (s1=E, s2=B, s4=A, s5=D) with variations on s3 and s5 to improve upon configuration 38.
s1=E with s2=B, s4=A, s5=D achieves minimal f2 (config 38: 1920). Testing s3=E explores potential lower f2; also testing s1=B, s3=D with varying s2/s4 targets extreme f1/f2 trade-offs.
Evaluate single-variable perturbations from the baseline across s1, s2, s3, s4, and s5 to probe individual label impacts and trade-offs.
s5=A reduces f2 without hurting f1, while s1=A and s3=A reduce f1 with minor f2 cost. Combining these promising labels and exploring untried s1/s5 labels can advance the Pareto front.
Combine beneficial sites: s1=A and s3=A reduce f1, s5=A improves f2, while testing untested levels for s3 and s5.
Evaluate s1=E with s3=C, s2=A with s3=C, and unmeasured labels on s5 (C, E) combined with top-performing s1=A and s1=E configurations to reduce f1 and f2.
s5=C achieved the best f2 (config 19). Combining s5=C with s3=C (lowest f1 among non-s2=A) and exploring s1=E/s1=D with s5=C should push the Pareto frontier further.
s5=C consistently optimizes f2, while s3=C achieves the best f1/f2 tradeoff. Exploring s1=C and s1=B with s3=C, s5=C and testing s3=D can discover non-dominated trade-offs.
s3=D and s5=C yield lowest f2, while s2=A drastically lowers f1. Testing s1={E,C,B} with s2=A and s3=D explores the extreme low-f1 frontier.
Test s2=A across remaining s3/s5 combinations to push the lowest f1 frontier, and explore remaining label interactions for s1=D with s3=D to target minimal f2.
s3=D and s5=C minimize both f1 and f2. Testing s1=C and s1=D with s4=B (ignored under s3=D) or testing other s5 variants with s3=D to discover Pareto trade-offs.
Test untested s5 levels (B and E) with dominant Pareto candidates (s1=D, s2=B, s3=D and s1=C, s2=A, s3=D) to discover further reductions in f1 and f2.
Initial exploration targeting diverse label settings across major independent sites s1, s3, and s5 to baseline main effects and establish trade-offs against the original configuration.
s1=B and s3=C show strong potential for very low f1, while s3=D keeps f2 low. Test variants with s1=B, s2=A, s4=A, and various s3/s5 to balance trade-offs.
s1=B and s2=A yield minimal f1, while s2=B yields minimal f2. We test s1=B with s2=A across varied s5 choices, and probe combinations targeting the intermediate trade-off space.
s1=B, s2=A, s4=A yields minimal f1, with s5=D giving the best f1/f2. Testing alternative s3 values (A, E) with these optimal settings to explore further gains in f1 and f2.
s1=B, s2=A, s4=A yields minimal f1, with s5=D optimal. Testing s1=C or other combinations with s2=B, s4=B to find lower f2 while reducing f1 below 233k.

s5=D significantly optimizes both objectives across configurations. Combining s2=B, s4=B with other s1 and s3 values (e.g. s1=A,C,D) explores lowest f2 values while searching for lower f1 under low f2.
Investigate low-f2 configurations around s5=D with s3=C or s3=E paired with s4=B, and explore s1=D variants where f2 was minimized.
Test s1=D with s2=A across remaining sites to exploit lowest f2 values, and explore other s5 labels with the current f2-minimal configuration (s1=D, s2=B, s3=B, s4=B).
Testing s4=A on low f2 champions (s3=B, s5=D) to see if s4=A yields lower f2 or balanced f1/f2 trade-offs without the high cost of s2=A.
Evaluations 42, 45, and 46 revealed a high-f2 trade-off zone where s4=A yields lower f2 than other s4=A points. Testing s1=B,C with s3=D, s4=A or testing s3=D on D with s2=B optimizes this frontier.
Initial exploration across diverse site assignments to assess sensitivity and main effects on both objectives relative to the baseline.
s4=A strongly correlates with minimal f2 (~2.7k), while s1=A and s5=A yield very low f1. Testing combinations of s4=A with s1=A,B,D to find optimal trade-offs between f1 and f2.
s2=A sharply reduces f1 while s2=B optimizes f2. s1=A and s3=A provide top f1; testing s1=A, s2=A with variations in s3, s4, and s5 aims to discover intermediate Pareto trade-offs.
s2=A drastically lowers f1 while raising f2; s3=A and s4=B provide ultra-low f1 (runs 2, 14). Testing s1=A, s2=A, s3=A, s4=B with other s5 labels may optimize f1 further.
s1=A and s4=B heavily reduce f1, while s2=B yields low f2. Testing s1=A, s2=B with s4=B across varied s3/s5 to check for an optimal compromise.
Testing s2=A with s4=B and s3=C or s5=E explores low f1 and f2 trade-offs; testing B at s1 with s3=C/s2=B explores the low-f2 boundary.
Testing s1=E with s4=B on low-f1 region variations (s3=D, s3=B) and s1=E with s2=B, s4=A to find potential new Pareto-optimal trade-offs at low f2.
Exploration near low-f1 configurations using s1=E, s2=A, s4=B with varied s3 and s5, and probing s2=B low f2 options.
Testing s1=B with s3=D and s2=B/s4=A for low f2, and exploring s1=E with s3=E or s1=D variants to break Pareto limits.
Test s1=E with s2=B across candidate low-f2 settings, and examine untested s1=C configurations or s3=B combinations targeting lower f2 boundary improvements.
Probe orthogonal primary dimensions (s1, s3, s5) and binary toggles (s2, s4) across diverse labels to establish initial main-effect trends relative to the baseline.
s4=B keeps f2 low (~2.6k) while s4=A significantly raises f2. s1=A and s2=A yielded extremely low f1. Testing s1=A and s1=B combined with s4=B to find configurations minimizing both f1 and f2.
s2=B minimizes f2 while s2=A lowers f1. Combining s1=A, s3=B, and s4=A with s2=B or testing s5 variations may yield strong trade-offs across the Pareto frontier.
s1=A, s2=A, s4=A yields very low f1; s3=C and s5=B/C may lower f2 further. Combining s1=A, s2=A with varying s3 and s5 tests unexplored low-f1, moderate-f2 trade-offs.
s2=A drives very low f1 with s4=A, while s2=B, s4=B minimizes f2. We test s1=B with s3=D and investigate s5 variation to push both Pareto extrema further.
s1=B and s2=A yield minimal f1 when s4=A, while s5=B improves both costs. Evaluating unexplored s5 values (C, D) and testing s3=E or s1=D combinations to uncover better trade-offs.
Test s1=B,C,E with s2=A/B and explore s5 variations to discover better trade-offs near the low-f1 Pareto boundary (s3=D, s4=A) and low-f2 boundary (s4=B, s2=B).
Test C and D on s1 with low-f2 configurations (s2=B, s4=B, s5=B) and s3 variations to explore improvements on Pareto points 21 and 34.
Explores combinations with s1=D and s2=B to further optimize the low-f2 region, tests s1=D with s3=B/E, and probes s1=C under s4=A for potential non-dominated trade-offs.
s1=D, s2=B, s5=B achieves lowest f2, especially with s3=E. Evaluating s1=D with s3=E and variations, as well as testing s1=C with s3=E to potentially improve f1-f2 trade-offs.
Explore orthogonal choices across s1, s3, and s5 while varying binary flags s2 and s4 to identify strong main effects relative to the baseline.
Combine s1=B (which gave extremely low f1) with s4=B and s2=A (associated with low f2) to test potential Pareto improvements.
s4=B yields very low f2 (~2.8k) while s2=B yields very low f1 (~6k). Testing s2=B with s4=B combines both effects to explore potential Pareto improvements in trade-off regions.
Eval 2 achieved the lowest f1 (6233) with s4=A and s2=B. Testing variations with s4=A paired with s2=B across promising s3 and s5 values to reproduce or improve minimal f1.
s4=A massively reduces f1 while s2=A yields low f2 (~2800). Test s2=A with s4=A on top of promising s1/s3 backgrounds to find better trade-offs.
Test s4=B with low f2 choices (s2=A, s1=A/B/E), exploring whether combining s1=B, s2=A, s3=C or other unexplored combinations can push the low-f2 boundary below 2688.
Test s1=D and s1=C with s2=B, s4=A to seek extreme low f1, and test s1=D/C with s2=A, s4=B to find low f2 trade-offs.
Explores minimal f1 through s3=B combinations, tests s1=E with s2=B for potentially low costs, and checks s1=B, s2=B, s3=B with variations on s5.
Combine top low-cost labels (s1=E or B with s3=B or A) and s5=C which showed favorable f1/f2 tradeoffs; also test s1=C with low-f1 features to explore unvisited interactions.
s5=C substantially reduces f2 across regions. Testing s5=C combined with elite low-f1 branches (s1=B, s2=B, s4=A) and best f2 branches (s2=A, s4=B) to push both Pareto fronts.
Explore diverse settings across primary independent sites s1, s3, and s5 while varying s2 and s4 to identify strong main effects and establish initial trade-offs relative to the baseline.
Evaluations show s5=B dramatically reduces f1 while s4=B preserves low f2. We test combinations of s5=B with s4=B and explore s1=B or s3=C/A to discover low f1 and balanced f2 points.
s2=B strongly reduces f1 while s2=A lowers f2. Testing combinations of s1=B or D with s2=B and s4=A (which lowered f1 drastically in config 3 vs 8) to find optimal trade-offs.
s2=B with s4=A yields ultra-low f1, while s1=A gives lower f2 than s1=B. Combining s1=A, s2=B, s4=A with s3=C and exploring varied s5 labels (D, C, E) targets non-dominated points near minimum f1.
Combine top f1 performer s1=B, s2=B, s4=A with s5=C (which gave the lowest f2 among low f1 configs) and test s1=C with s2=B to explore better f2 trade-offs.
Explores combinations around the extreme Pareto points: testing C with s2=B across varying s5 to minimize f1 further, and testing s1=E with s3=E to seek improvements on minimum f2.
s1=C, s2=B, s4=A yields low f1/f2 in the f1-optimized region, testing s3=B. Also test s1=E, s2=A with s3=C, s4=B, s5=D for f2-optimal trade-offs.

Exploration shows s2=A with s4=B minimizes f2, while s2=B with s4=A minimizes f1. We test combinations of s1 in {D, C} with s3 in {A, E, C} aiming to bridge or advance the low-f2 and low-f1 Pareto fronts.
s1=D and s5=C achieved the best f2 (2496). We test s1=D with various s3 choices and s5=C, or alternative s2/s4 combos, to improve f2 further while maintaining low costs.
Test s1=E with s5=C and s4=B to explore whether s1=E can achieve an even lower f2 than s1=D (which gave 2304), and test s1=E with s2=B for low f1.
Exploration begins by testing single and pairwise variations across key parameters s1, s2, s3, and s5 relative to the baseline to uncover main effects.
Test combination of f1-reducing s1=B and s2=A with f2-reducing s5=B, plus explore remaining values of s1 and s5.
Combine strong f1-reducing s1=C and s1=E with s2=A, and explore untested levels of s3 and s5 along low f2/f1 trade-offs.
s1=D has shown the best f1 among low f2 configs; evaluating s1=D with s3/s5 variations, and testing unexplored s3 labels (C, D, E) to seek superior Pareto trade-offs.
Combining s1=C and s2=A yielded the lowest f1 values, while s3=C further reduces f1. We test s3=C with s2=A across s1=C and s1=B, and explore s5 variants with s3=C.
Test s5 labels (D, E) with the Pareto-optimal s1=C/s3=C/s2=A and s1=D/s3=C/s2=B baselines, and explore s1=E with s3=C to find improved trade-offs.
Combining s5=E, which drastically reduced f2 in config 30, with s2=B and other s1 variants or exploring s3=C with s1=A and s5=E to improve Pareto coverage.
Exploit optimal s3=C and s5=E across untested s1/s2 combinations and test s5=C/D on top Pareto performers to find lower f1 or f2 values.
s5=E strongly reduces f2, while s3=C yields low f1. Testing s1=E with s5=E, and s3=D/A with s5=E explores potential new Pareto extrema.
s5=E consistently achieves lowest f2, while s3=C yields low f1. Testing s1=C with s2=A, s3=C, s5=C checks unexplored s5 variants, and testing s3=B or D with s5=E explores trade-offs.
Sample diverse values across the key categorical variables s1, s3, and s5 relative to the baseline to uncover main effects on f1 and f2 across the search space.
Combine top f1 performer s2=B and top f2 setting s5=A with beneficial s1=A and s3=B, while also exploring remaining labels in s1 and s3.
Combine top f1 factors (s1=A, s2=B, s3=B) and test remaining labels for s3 and s5 to discover improved trade-offs along the Pareto frontier.
Combine top f1 reductions (s1=A, s2=B, s3=B or C) with favorable f2 choices (s5=C) and explore untested s3=D and s5 variants to push the Pareto boundary.
s5=C consistently lowers f2, while s3=D and s2=B achieve the best f1. Testing s1=A and s1=D with s3=D and s5=C or exploring s5=D/E will refine the non-dominated frontier.
s1=E is untested; test if it offers better trade-offs. Also evaluate s1=B with s3=D and s5=C, and s1=D with s5=A or alternative s5 values to optimize the Pareto front.
Test s1=E across other s3 and s5 values to find better Pareto trade-offs, and test s1=B with s5=A or other labels to push minimal f2 further down.
s5=B with s1=B, s3=D, s2=A yielded lowest f2 historically. Testing s5=B on Pareto fronts and exploring s1=C/D interactions with s3=D.
Combine Pareto-optimal settings s3=D and s5=C across s1 variants, while exploring untried s1=C with s2=B or testing s1=E across missing configurations.
Evaluating s1=E with s3=E or s3=A at s5=C tests unexplored branches for s1=E, while checking s1=E with s2=B (canonical s2=A due to s1=E) is redundant.
Initial exploration across diverse parameter values to establish baseline sensitivity along different dimensions away from the initial default configuration.
Test low f2 configurations with promising f1 reductions from s1=D or s3=E while preserving low f2 (s5=B, s3=B/D). Explore interactions to break the trade-off.
High f2 values appear strongly linked to s2=B or s4=A/s5!=B, while s3=A/E achieved very low f1. Testing s1=D and s1=A with s3=A and original settings to seek low f1 with small f2.
Configurations 4 and 6 achieve very low f1 with s2=B. Testing s2=B across promising s1/s3/s5 combinations to trade modest f2 increases for large f1 reductions.
s2=B with s3=E yields extremely low f1. Testing variation in s4 and s5 with s2=B, s3=E, and s1 in {D, E} to probe lower f2 while preserving low f1.
Investigate the high-performing s3=E, s4=A branch with s1=E/A across untested s5 values (C, D) and s1=E with s5=A to push the low f1 Pareto boundary.
Test s1=B with s2=B, s3=E, s4=A, s5=A to seek low f2 in the ultra-low f1 cluster, and explore s2=A with s5=A across candidates to minimize f2.
Test s1 variations with s3=E, s4=A, s5=A and s2 combinations; also explore s2=A with s3=A, s5=A across remaining untested permutations to discover lower f2 or f1 tradeoffs.
Test s2=A with s3=C or s3=D to target low-to-mid f1 and f2 trade-offs, and explore s1 variations for promising low f2 points.
Test s4=A on low-f2 baseline s3=A to potentially reduce f1 while maintaining low f2, and test s3=D with s2=B, s4=A for ultralow f1.
